title: Mexican Irish Fish Skewers
description: A fusion of Irish and Mexican flavors, these fish skewers are marinated in a mixture of lime juice, chili powder, and spices before being grilled to perfection.
instructions: Cut the salmon fillets into 1-inch cubes.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, chili powder, garlic powder, cumin powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the salmon cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread the marinated salmon onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the fish is cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped cilantro.
